firstRun.title: Nowhere saved yet
firstRun.body: Add a place — home, the cabin, a trailhead — and byge will tell you whether it is raining there and for how long, straight from MET Norway's radar. Everything stays on this device.

removed.title: {{name}} removed.
removed.body: That was your last saved place, so there is nothing left to check. It is gone from this device — there is no account and no sync, so nothing else is holding a copy.

confirm.removeBody: This deletes the place and its saved answer from this device. There is no account and no sync, so it cannot be brought back.

install.body: Keep byge one tap away — add it to your home screen. Works offline with the last verdict.

stale.offline: Showing the verdict from {{age}} min ago — you are offline. It will refresh the moment you are back.

about.what: byge reads MET Norway’s radar nowcast for your exact coordinate and tells you whether it is raining, and for how long. Nothing else.
about.notAffiliated: Not affiliated with, or endorsed by, MET Norway or NRK.
about.advection: Forecast frames are advection-only: the measured rain field slides along measured motion. Cells do not grow or die, so far-out frames are weaker — which is what the confidence marker tells you.
about.horizon: The horizon is 115 minutes. When a spell is still going at the horizon, byge reports a lower bound and says so. It will never round an unknown into a number.
about.blind: Where the radar cannot see, byge says so rather than saying “dry”. Those are different claims.

refresh.latestAge: Already the latest — radar {{age}} min old.
refresh.hint: Check MET Norway for a newer radar analysis

coverage.blindTitle: No radar coverage — we cannot see this place.
coverage.blindBody: That is not the same as dry: we have no observation at all, so byge makes no claim either way.
coverage.partial: Radar sees only {{percent}}% of your area — the rest is outside coverage and not included either way.

error.title: Could not reach the radar
error.body: You are online — the request to MET Norway failed. There is no saved answer for this place yet, so byge has nothing to show. It will not guess.
error.inline: Refresh failed — this is still the answer from before.

legend.title: Reading the list
legend.filledBody: Raining there right now. The colour is how hard.
legend.outlineBody: Dry now, but a spell is on the way within the next two hours.
legend.hatchedBody: Outside radar coverage — we have no observation at all.

field.coordHint: Four decimals max — MET rejects anything finer. That is about 11 m, far inside a single 1 km radar cell, so nothing is lost.

radius.hint: Any rain touching the circle counts as rain here, so widening only ever adds — it can never turn a wet answer dry. The grid is 1 km, so below 2 km there is nothing finer to see.
radius.wide: A wide watch area. Some rain somewhere within {{km}} km over the next two hours is very nearly always true in Norway, so the answer stops discriminating. That is what the 3 km default protects.
radius.costly: It is also about 350 KB of radar per check at 25 km, against 8 KB at 3 km — a cost, not a limit.
radius.valueMin: {{km}} km — as narrow as the 1 km grid supports

add.nameHint: Shown in your list of places.

verdict.notSaved: This place is not saved on this device.
verdict.unreachable: MET Norway did not answer, and nothing is cached for this place yet.

map.pick: Pick a place — pan the map to move the marker
map.locateHint: Centres the map on your device. You still confirm the place.
map.blockedTitle: Location is blocked for this site
map.blockedBody: Your browser will not ask again from here. On iOS: Settings › Safari › Location. On Android and desktop: the padlock in the address bar. Meanwhile you can pan the map or type the coordinates.
map.unsupportedTitle: This device cannot report a location
map.unsupportedBody: Pan the map or type the coordinates instead.
map.failedBody: The device did not answer in time. Try again, or pan the map instead.
map.outsideBody: The Nordic radar does not reach here, so this place would have no answer to give — not a dry one, none. Pan the marker back inside the grid.
